rationale.complete: Round 1 done: synthetic validation first (it broke and then fixed the estimator before real data), dated predictions, 33 replication folders plus 3 native tests (NE43, G38, G04), operator rule with split-half and bootstrap reliability, scorecard. Confirmatory script written and dry-run on stand-ins; holdout not run. Nudge and human curves are underpowered.
rationale.faithfulness: The core claim is refuted: no refractory window, the window does not track the launched episode, and the episode-lock signature (recoverable in the synthetic) is absent; R stays 0.8-1.3 at all spacings. Only the mechanical same-call absorption (P4) and the cross-NE43 invariance (P7) hold. Scorecard A1 B1 C1 D0 E1 F1 G1 H1 I1; no holdout.
rationale.usefulness: A clear, validated-in-sample negative design rule an operator can act on: re-kick after one read-out, not after a task episode; never stack kicks before the recipient's next model call; the nudger's 15-min floor is already past refractoriness, and its real limit is that nudges buy glances rather than sustained work. Evidence is strongest for mentions (G51, 15-period pool) and weaker for humans and nudges.

one_line: Kicks leave no refractory window: a second kick read by a later model call keeps 80-130% of the first's effect; same-read kicks are wasted.

models.note: no refractory recovery function; R 0.8-1.3 at all spacings
SIRS-like refractory compartment absent; no episode lock

v2.claim: No refractory window beyond one read-out; only same-call kicks are wasted
v2.rater: 2 raters (coordinator + blind); log-odds mean credence, mean V

raters.claim: Scope: 35 non-holdout periods (mentions identifiable at G51 scale; humans in G04; nudges marginal). Kicks leave no refractory window: a second kick read at a later model call keeps ~80-130% of a first kick's effect at every spacing from 1 min to 4 h; only kicks read in the same call are discounted (R 0.2-0.4).

ladder.factor: calibrated null and identified: synthetic null near 1, planted 30-min habituation recovered; rule reliable 98-100% (one design, credited once)
partial replication: mentions pooled over 15 periods R 0.78; humans G04; nudges G51
intervention partly consistent: mention R invariant across NE43
penalty: estimated call starts misclassify same/next-call pairs; nudge R on a post hoc outcome
